about.p1: I am an Advanced Postdoctoral Researcher at the University of Bern, Switzerland, working at the Pattern Recognition Group on SNSF-funded research. My expertise spans graph neural networks, spatio-temporal deep learning, and LLM-based AI systems.
about.p2: I received my Ph.D. from INSA Rouen (France) in 2021, focusing on graph kernels and chemoinformatics. Since then, I've contributed to projects in computational chemistry, document analysis, and environmental science.
about.p3: Beyond academia, I serve as Chief AI Officer at N-Banker, a FinTech startup, where I lead AI strategy and LLM agent development.
about.p4: I am actively seeking ML Research Scientist opportunities in AI-driven drug discovery, scientific computing, and production AI systems.
